name: Customer
definition: A registered fuel-card customer of the programme, identified by a unique numeric customer identifier. Each customer carries exactly one segment classification and exactly one settlement currency.
scope: Customer-level analysis of consumption and card transactions in the debit_card_specializing database

name: Gas Station
definition: A fuel station where card transactions take place, identified by a unique numeric station identifier and classified by chain, country and station type.
scope: Station-level location and classification analysis of transactions

name: Product
definition: A fuel or lubricant article that can be purchased at a station, identified by a unique numeric product identifier and labelled by a text description.
scope: Product-level purchase analysis in the debit_card_specializing database

name: Transaction
definition: A single card purchase event recorded at a gas station, stamped with a calendar date and clock time and linked to a customer, a station, a product, a purchased amount and a price.
scope: Event-level analysis of individual fuel purchases

name: Customer Segment
definition: The classification of customers into the mutually exclusive categories SME, LAM and KAM. Each customer belongs to exactly one category, and the category is a static attribute of the customer record with no history.
scope: Grouping of customers for consumption comparison, e.g. the three segments SME, LAM and KAM

name: Payment Currency
definition: The currency in which a customer settles fuel payments, recorded as CZK (Czech koruna) or EUR (euro). Currency is attached to the customer, not to individual transactions or monthly consumption records.
scope: Currency-scoped consumption and transaction analysis; used to interpret expressions such as 'paid in CZK', 'paid in EUR' and 'pays in euro'

name: Year-Month Period
definition: A calendar month of consumption. Month periods are stored as six-character codes in the form YYYYMM: the first four characters are the four-digit year and the last two characters are the two-digit month. Only the yearmonth table carries this encoding.
scope: Month-level and year-level consumption analysis such as peak month, monthly average and year-over-year comparison

name: Transaction Date
definition: The calendar day on which a transaction took place, stored in ISO form (YYYY-MM-DD) on the transaction record. Distinct from the year-month code used for consumption.
scope: Day-level transaction filtering such as 'after 2012/1/1' or 'on 2012/8/23'

name: Transaction Time
definition: The clock time of day at which a transaction took place, stored as eight-character HH:MM:SS text on the transaction record.
scope: Time-of-day analysis of transactions, e.g. listing the distinct times of transactions at a given station chain

name: Gas Station Chain
definition: A grouping of gas stations that share the same numeric chain identifier. A chain identifier is a number, so expressions such as 'chain no. 11' denote the chain whose identifier is 11. A chain groups several stations; a station belongs to one chain.
scope: Chain-level restriction of stations and their transactions

name: Gas Station Country
definition: The country where a gas station is located, coded as CZE for the Czech Republic and SVK for Slovakia.
scope: Country-scoped station and transaction analysis, e.g. transactions made at gas stations in the Czech Republic

name: Gas Station Segment
definition: The station-type classification of a gas station, with the value domain Discount, Noname, Other, Premium and Value for money. This is a station property and is a different concept from the customer segment, even though both are stored in a column named Segment.
scope: Station-type scoped analysis; must not be confused with customer segments SME/LAM/KAM

name: Product Description
definition: The human-readable name of a product, such as 'Diesel' or 'Natural', used to identify a product in output listings.
scope: Labelling products in purchase listings; the product identifier alone is not human readable

name: Customer Monthly Consumption
definition: The quantity of fuel consumed by one customer in one calendar month. It is recorded as a signed real number at customer-month grain, so there is at most one consumption value per customer per month.
scope: Month-level consumption analysis per customer, and the base quantity for any segment- or year-level consumption aggregate

name: Annual Consumption
definition: Total consumption of a customer, segment or currency group over one calendar year, formed by combining that year's monthly consumption values. It has no stored column and must be constructed from month-level records.
scope: Year-over-year comparison and per-segment annual totals

name: Average Monthly Consumption
definition: The average monthly consumption for a year. In this workload it is defined as the mean of the monthly consumption values observed for the year divided by 12, i.e. the year's consumption expressed as a per-month figure spread over twelve months.
scope: Average-consumption comparison across customers and segments for a given year

name: Consumption Growth Rate
definition: The percentage change in consumption for a group between two consecutive years. In this workload it is defined as the increase or decrease between the two years expressed as a percentage of the later year's consumption.
scope: Year-over-year growth comparison across the three customer segments

name: Peak Consumption Month
definition: The calendar month that shows the highest aggregate consumption for a given customer group and year, identified by its month code.
scope: Peak-month identification within a year for a segment or the whole customer base

name: Least Consuming Customer
definition: The customer holding the smallest total consumption within a given segment and year. It serves as a selection base when a comparison is restricted to the least consuming customers of each segment.
scope: Ranking-based restriction of customers before forming per-segment averages

name: Transaction Amount
definition: The quantity purchased in a single transaction, recorded as an integer on the transaction record. Values observed range from 0 to 264, and 91 transactions have amount 0.
scope: Per-event purchase quantity; distinct from monthly consumption, because it is not aggregated to a customer-month figure

name: Transaction Price
definition: The monetary amount recorded for a single transaction, observed in the range 1.76 to 5762.49. No currency column is attached to the transaction record, so the currency of a price follows the currency of the paying customer.
scope: Per-event monetary value analysis
